tool_args.rationale: The open-branch measurements add gradient variation to the monotone, concave pilot and support fitting the recalled subcritical saturating sink-gradient mechanism. Fresh confirmation is needed because the supercritical branch remains unidentified.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the sink-gradient dependence revealed by the open-branch observations.
The observed concave saturation and gradient dependence are more directly represented by the recalled saturating mechanism.
Its threshold and strength cannot be fitted from observations at or below s_grad 2.35; the recommended high-gradient probe is not in the available menu.
The available description does not establish that it samples the unidentified high-gradient regime.
